messages:
maya: Heads-up — support ticket SUP-9876 from AcmeChat. They report a sudden p99 jump to ~3.2s on /v1/generate starting ~12:10 UTC, correlated with continuous-batcher being enabled for their route. Anyone oncall?
chris: I'm on it. Do we have traces or logs?
sre-bot: Alert: route=acmechat.generate p99 latency ↑ 3200ms, last_seen=3332109800, affected_replicas=3, batcher=continuous, config=adaptive_linger=true
maya: We rolled adaptive_linger to true last week for throughput gains, but this looks like tiny prompt microbursts hitting hold-window interactions.
lin: Repro attempt in staging with similar traffic shape (lots of tiny prompts + occasional big prompt). I can repro p99 tails when small requests momentarily block a batch waiting window and then a big request arrives.
amanda: Can you paste the minimal repro curl?
lin: Sure — single-threaded script that matches customer:
```bash
# 1) pump 50 tiny requests (10-25 tokens) at ~100rps
for i in {1..50}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi","max_tokens":10}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" & done
# 2) then send one 300-token request
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"long...","max_tokens":300}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```
lin: Observed one long tail response in step 2 when continuous_batcher tried to coalesce into the same batch.
chris: Logs from the affected replica: `continuous_batcher.cpp: enqueue_wait(hold_window_ms=8, current_batch_count=4) -> delayed until max_wait_ms=120` then big request arrives and waits on KV cache swap = added 2.9s.
support-agent: Customer wants ETA, they're on a paid SLA. Ticket updated that it's being investigated.
maya: Quick mitigation: revert adaptive_linger flag for AcmeChat route to false and pin to batch_size_max=8, hold_window_ms=4 for now. That should reduce long waits for large requests.
chris: I'm applying route patch now (will route to non-adaptive linger). deploy-bot: deploy started for route=acmechat.generate by chris @3332110000
chris: Patch applied to 3 replicas. Early telemetry shows p99 down to ~500ms for the customer path.
lin: Mitigation confirmed in staging/production smoke. We should also add route-level opt-out header to bypass continuous batching for realtime customers: `x-rw-batching: none`.
amanda: Follow-ups: 1) create an incident ticket and tag infra for batcher kernel investigation 2) add an e2e repro in perf harness 3) consider changing default adaptive_linger rollout to canary with qps-based gating.
maya: I'll open ENG-12011 for postmortem and add measurement deck. Also schedule a perf job to sweep hold_window_ms vs max_wait_ms tradeoffs for mixed microburst workloads.
sre-bot: Note saved: rollback=adaptive_linger:false route=acmechat.generate, metric_check p95/p99 showing improvement at 3332110300.
chris: Temporary customer note sent. Will keep monitoring for next 2 hours. If we see <5% error/noise we'll close the escalation.
amanda: Long-term action: allow route-level policy to pick batching strategy (continuous | microbatch | none) and expose safe defaults in Console.
maya: Great. Thanks all.
